model: New illustrated detail inside each parent scene; original singles are separate.

scenes.title: Rose Cottage: Inside
scenes.blurb: Six illustrated discoveries inside this artwork. Rose Cottage → Through the window → The botanical book → The bee on the page.

levels.label: Through the window
levels.relation: A reading nook is revealed through the ground-floor window of this cottage.

levels.label: The botanical book
levels.relation: The rose illustration on the right-hand page of the open book gains new botanical detail.

levels.label: The bee on the page
levels.relation: The honeybee already printed above the rose is revealed in finer detail.

levels.label: Inside its wing
levels.relation: The translucent upper wing of that illustrated bee reveals finer veins and pollen.

levels.label: A pollen grain
levels.relation: The central pollen grain already visible on the wing gains its surface structure.

levels.label: Within the pollen pore
levels.relation: The central pore of that same pollen grain reveals its reticulated wall.

scenes.title: Camellia & Bee: Inside
scenes.blurb: Six illustrated discoveries inside this artwork. Camellia & Bee → The visiting bee → Wing membrane → Pollen surface.

levels.label: The visiting bee
levels.relation: The bee already hovering beside the camellia is revealed closely.

levels.label: Wing membrane
levels.relation: The broad upper wing cell of that bee reveals its finer membrane and pollen.

levels.label: Pollen surface
levels.relation: The round grain in the centre of that wing membrane reveals its reticulated surface.

levels.label: Inside the pore
levels.relation: The grain central pore reveals finer folds and wall cells.

levels.label: The cell wall
levels.relation: The central rounded wall cell reveals branching fibres and membrane folds.

levels.label: Membrane detail
levels.relation: The central membrane compartment reveals still finer organic microtexture.

scenes.title: Barn Owl: Inside
scenes.blurb: Six illustrated discoveries inside this artwork. The barn owl → A wing feather → The dew reflection → An oak leaf.

levels.label: A wing feather
levels.relation: A long feather already present on the owl wing reveals barbs and a small dew droplet.

levels.label: The dew reflection
levels.relation: The dew droplet between the feather barbs contains the reflected oak branch above the owl.

levels.label: An oak leaf
levels.relation: The large reflected oak leaf reveals its finer veins and a tiny leaf beetle.

levels.label: The leaf beetle
levels.relation: The beetle already resting on that leaf reveals its ridged wing cases.

levels.label: Wing-case scales
levels.relation: The oval patch within that beetle wing case reveals overlapping micro-scales.

levels.label: Within one scale
levels.relation: One central lattice cell on the same wing-case scale reveals finer pigment texture.

scenes.title: Coral Turtle: Inside
scenes.blurb: Six illustrated discoveries inside this artwork. The coral turtle → A shell scute → A tiny barnacle → The calcite plate.

levels.label: A shell scute
levels.relation: One plate of the turtle shell reveals growth contours and a tiny attached barnacle.

levels.label: A tiny barnacle
levels.relation: The barnacle already on that shell plate reveals its six calcite plates.

levels.label: The calcite plate
levels.relation: A central barnacle plate reveals finer mineral growth and a tiny spiral micro-shell.

levels.label: A micro-shell
levels.relation: The spiral micro-shell on that calcite plate reveals its curved chambers.

levels.label: Mineral chambers
levels.relation: The mineral rosette inside that spiral reveals finer cell-like facets.

levels.label: Crystal detail
levels.relation: The central mineral compartment reveals new lamellar folds and tiny crystal chambers.

scenes.title: Gentle Daisy: Inside
scenes.blurb: Six illustrated discoveries inside this artwork. Gentle daisies → A tiny ladybird → A dewdrop reflection → Inside the daisy disk.

levels.label: A tiny ladybird
levels.relation: The upper daisy disk reveals its florets and a tiny ladybird resting on them.

levels.label: A dewdrop reflection
levels.relation: The central spot on the ladybird wing case reveals a dewdrop holding a daisy reflection.

levels.label: Inside the daisy disk
levels.relation: The centre of the reflected daisy reveals cup-shaped florets and a pollen grain.

levels.label: A pollen grain
levels.relation: That central pollen grain reveals new rounded surface cells and folds.

levels.label: One surface cell
levels.relation: The broad central surface cell reveals internal compartments and membranes.

levels.label: The smallest folds
levels.relation: The central oval membrane reveals its smallest folds and rounded granules.
